name: Pipeline Pulse
summary: Build your own pipeline, solve graded incident challenges, and compare worker capacity against a completion target. Save named experiments and return to your investigations.
review: Failed-activity priorities, recovery coverage and capacity handoffs

name: DataLens
summary: Turn a dataset into a living quality map. Write contracts, find the exact failures, and compare distribution shifts against a baseline.
review: Contract coverage gaps and failing-rule review priorities

name: Recon Lab
summary: Move beyond row counts. Investigate field-level differences, model tolerance policies, and trace every exception to its source.
review: Keyset exceptions and field-level reconciliation priorities

name: Runbook Radar
summary: Explore how search actually works. Compare BM25 and TF-IDF, inspect term contributions, and evaluate retrieval against labeled questions.
review: Evaluation coverage, top-K misses and no-match review

name: Privacy Forge
summary: Design a column-by-column transformation policy. Explore what stays useful, what remains exposed, and how small groups can reveal more than expected.
review: Retained signals, singleton groups and policy review
